name: Waking Palm
description: Strike with a palm that wakes a drowsy foe to the plain fact of the blow.

name: Lucid Guard
description: Turn a dreamlike feint aside by knowing at once which arm is real.

name: Dreamer Step
description: Step through a dreamed room as through a real one and come out where the truth says.

name: Wake Sight
description: See at once whether a scene before the eyes is waking or dreamed.

name: Dream Pierce
description: Pierce the thin skin of a foe's dream with a bright point and let it deflate.

name: Unreal Cut
description: Cut along the line where the dream ends and the real begins and wound on that side.

name: Wake Ward
description: Hold a ward that lets in only what is real and turns every dreamed blow.

name: Fiction Lift
description: Lift the grip of a dreamed charm or a false memory from an ally's mind.

name: Dream Undone
description: Unpick the whole dream a foe has woven about the ground and leave only the plain scene.

name: Waking Spear
description: Drive a spear of waking light through the dream guard of a foe to his true body.

name: Fiction Ended
description: End every dreamed and false thing across the qi field in a single bright pulse.

name: Waking Verdict
description: streams: Truth + Dream; show the dreamed world as it is and strike the dreamer in the waking mind.

name: Loom Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a thread of the loom into the foe's sense of the blow.

name: Warp Guard
description: Hold a guard of taut threads that catches a blow on its crossing strands.

name: Weave Feeling
description: Feel the threads of a foe's perception and learn which of them are plucked.

name: Perception Weave
description: Weave a false scene into a foe's sight and hold it taut for a few breaths.

name: Key Thread
description: Pull the key thread of the weave and watch the whole false scene run out.

name: Shuttle Cut
description: Cut through the weave like a shuttle so the blow arrives from inside the foe's sense.

name: Clear Cloth
description: Spread a bolt of clear cloth before the body that sheds both blades and glamours.

name: Unravelling
description: Unravel the perception of a whole group until each of them sees the plain ground alone.

name: Fabric Rend
description: Rend the fabric of a foe's perception and strike the body that hides behind it.

name: Loom Pulse
description: Send a pulse of the loom through the qi field that cancels every woven falsehood.

name: Dream Reckoning
description: streams: Truth + Dream; weave a dream about the foe and unweave it in a single blow of reckoning.
